visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a chef wearing a white uniform and purple latex gloves using a high-intensity blowtorch to sear pieces of food on a teppanyaki grill. Sparks and flames are visible. (2) The camera transitions to an outdoor setting at the entrance of a building. A large white Japanese-style lantern with black and blue logos stands prominently near a glass door. (3) A female adult wearing a pink and white striped sweater, carrying shopping bags, and holding a child's hand walks toward a restaurant staff member dressed in black who is holding a tablet. (4) A male individual with short, dark hair and a black backpack appears in a selfie-style shot in front of the large lantern, making an exaggerated, surprised facial expression. (5) Inside the restaurant, the female and the young child are seen sitting at a dark, polished counter near large silver cloches. The background features warm lighting and a clean, modern aesthetic. (6) A wide shot looks through large floor-to-ceiling windows showing a misty, rainy view of a coastal city and a bridge in the distance. (7) A person's hand flips through a physical menu titled '明水然·樂' displaying various food sets and prices including $1,600 and $2,400. (8) A rapid series of close-ups showcases various fresh ingredients: raw lobsters in a silver bowl, a perfectly cooked square of wagyu beef on a black plate, a seared scallop garnished with toppings, and a platter of fresh red fish and other seafood. (9) A chef is shown vigorously stir-frying rice on the flat grill using metal spatulas, followed by a final shot of a bowl of salmon fried rice and a young girl standing near the restaurant entrance.
